name: Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition
description: Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person role-playing game, an enhanced edition of the second in the Neverwinter Nights series.

eax.problem: This is the 2025 Enhanced Edition, not the classic Neverwinter Nights 2, and it has no EAX.

notes: If you also own the classic Neverwinter Nights 2, it's a separate GOG purchase, 'Neverwinter Nights 2 Complete', and that one has EAX.
